fix: The Roman shields, that is, made a great difference for protection, and their swords for action [...], while the Gallic sword could only deliver a downward cut.
reason: Lacuna after μεγάλην διαφορὰν must be marked [...] per convention; drop unsupported comparatives; candidate's '[text missing in the Greek]' violates convention.

fix: may put all their own hopes to the test before yielding any of what is essential
reason: πάσας ἐξελέγχωσι τὰς σφετέρας ἐλπίδας: 'test all their hopes', not 'resources'.
πρόβλημα here is the Achaeans' dilemma, which the Corinthians' expulsion order resolved (next sentence); 'bulwark' would invert the sense.

fix: the killing of fellow citizens is held to be the gravest impiety, deserving the heaviest penalties
reason: τίθεται is impersonal 'is held'; English wrongly attributes the view to Phylarchus.
